description: Research conventions, citation standards, confidence annotation rules, and hypothesis lifecycle policy for this instance.

tier_assignment.A: Xavier-verified or primary source: original paper, direct experiment, owner decision, first-hand observation.
tier_assignment.B: Structured summary of A, or reputable third-party documentation with a traceable source URL.
tier_assignment.C: Model synthesis, brainstorm output, Supabase recall, unverified search result. Never cite as fact without promotion.

confidence_annotation.format: Append [A], [B], or [C] to any factual claim not originating from Xavier directly.

escalation_path.C_to_B: Locate a traceable secondary source (paper, doc, verified report).
escalation_path.B_to_A: Xavier verification or reproduction of the primary source.

confidence_annotation.blocking_rule: Tier C claims must never appear in proposals, synthesis docs, or governed-state artifacts without explicit promotion.

transitions.open_to_investigating: Xavier or Claude begins actively gathering evidence; at least one evidence_ref added.
transitions.investigating_to_answered: finding_summary written with tier B or A evidence; confidence >= 0.7.
transitions.investigating_to_abandoned: Question deprioritized; reason recorded in finding_summary.
transitions.answered_to_open: New contradicting evidence found; re-opened with a Tension note.
